mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer sector contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 114.0) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), reduced corporate capacity utilization and earnings pressure drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting INDPRO < 114.0 and UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 4.0% signals aggressive monetary easing that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand that typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 12mo MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 114.0 signals manufacturing contraction that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 114.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration that typically produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
